title: Introduce multimodal request preparation and image caption boundaries
description: AstrBot main-agent has separate concerns for image captioning, quoted image fallback, provider modality checks, and unsupported image replacement. Rust currently forwards image_urls through MessageChain/ProviderRequest and concrete providers. Add a dedicated multimodal preparation boundary before main-agent parity grows inside ProcessStage or providers.

files.change: Expose image caption, quoted image, and modality filter boundaries from astrbot-agent.
Define provider-selected image captioning and caption insertion without coupling it to ProcessStage.
Centralize image/tool modality fallback behavior before provider requests are sent.
Append quoted fallback image refs and attachment text through a typed policy separate from selected_text quote context.

criteria: ProcessStage does not grow image caption or modality fallback logic directly.
Provider adapters keep protocol serialization only.
Quote image fallback has a typed policy separate from selected_text quote context.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test --workspace
